title: Fast screening of gold in rock samples using polyurethane foam extraction and inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry determination
author: Hassan, Zari, et al.

steps.title: Prepare rock sample
steps.instruction: Grind, homogenize and quarter each rock sample, then pulverize the representative portion to approximately 200‑mesh particle size.

steps.title: Weigh sample
steps.instruction: Weigh exactly 10 g of the pulverized sample for the fire‑assay procedure.

steps.title: Remove sulfur (choose method)
steps.instruction: Either (a) roast the weighed sample at 600 °C for 2 h, or (b) add elemental iron to the smelting charge to suppress sulfur loss.

steps.title: Add flux components
steps.instruction: Mix the sample with lead oxide (20 g), sodium carbonate (25 g), sodium tetraborate (15 g) and reducing‑reagent flour (5 g) until the flux is uniformly distributed.

steps.title: Transfer to crucible
steps.instruction: Quantitatively transfer the flux‑sample mixture into a fire‑resistant crucible.

steps.title: Fusion of charge
steps.instruction: Place the crucible in a furnace and fuse the charge at 1070 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Pour melt into iron cup
steps.instruction: After fusion, pour the molten material into an iron cup and allow it to cool.

steps.title: Separate lead‑metal bead
steps.instruction: Separate the lead containing the precious‑metal bead from the slag by forging, then place the bead into a heated cupel.

steps.title: Cupellation
steps.instruction: Heat the cupel to a temperature between 890 °C and 940 °C and maintain for 20–30 min to oxidize the lead and leave a metallic bead (prill) at the bottom.

steps.title: Dissolve metallic bead
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 50 % (v/v) nitric acid to the bead, followed by 2 mL of aqua regia, and mix to dissolve the silver‑gold alloy.

steps.title: Form silver complexes
steps.instruction: Transfer the solution to a 100 mL volumetric flask and treat with 25 % (v/v) hydrochloric acid to convert silver to AgCl₂⁻ and AgCl₃²⁻ complexes.

steps.title: Prepare sample blank
steps.instruction: Process a blank using the same reagents and quantities as steps 2–10, but without adding any rock sample.

steps.title: Prepare gold standard solution
steps.instruction: Make 500 mL of a solution containing 40 µg L⁻¹ gold in 10 % HCl; verify the concentration by ICP‑MS.

steps.title: Extract gold with polyurethane foam
steps.instruction: Place a 1 × 1 × 1 cm piece of polyurethane foam into 50 mL of the 40 µg L⁻¹ gold solution (selected volume) and let it stand overnight (12 h) for adsorption.

substeps.instruction: Squeeze the foam after the 12 h extraction to recover the solution.
Immediately extract the adsorbed gold from the squeezed foam with 20 mL of 1 % thiourea solution in a boiling water bath at 100 °C for 20 min.
Do not rinse the foam after extraction; only squeeze it.
Collect the thiourea extract for analysis.

steps.title: Measure gold content
steps.instruction: Determine the amount of gold remaining in the unabsorbed solution and the amount extracted into the thiourea solution using ICP‑MS.
